findings: `learner.overview.text` overstates the pictograph interpretation as settled by saying 能 “is best understood as an old picture of a bear.” The proposed Shang forms are disputed, and the dossier does not settle the bear identification. Qualify the construction, for example: “能 is traditionally interpreted as a bear pictograph, though its proposed Shang forms are disputed.” Cite `X-f0f9e79e66127d73b16d` and `X-cdb7b2fe9f93f6c10752`.
